requirement.description: The next_token function has several critical flaws that prevent proper tokenization of PDF syntax elements. It fails to correctly identify and parse integers, real numbers, names, comments, and complex structures like dictionaries and arrays. Many tests are failing because the tokenizer doesn't properly recognize PDF token types.
requirement.contract: Function must correctly identify and return the proper token type (INTEGER, REAL, NAME, COMMENT, DICT, ARRAY, STRING, TRUE, FALSE, KEYWORD) with accurate start and end positions for all PDF syntax elements. It should properly handle nested structures, comments, and incomplete tokens.

requirement.description: The parse_obj function has critical implementation gaps in parsing dictionaries, arrays, and references. It fails to correctly parse nested structures and handle reference objects (like 6 0 R) properly. The function also has issues with parsing comments within arrays and dictionaries.
requirement.contract: Function must correctly parse PDF syntax elements including dictionaries (<< >>), arrays ([ ]), references (e.g., 6 0 R), booleans, strings, integers, and real numbers. It should handle nested structures properly and correctly convert reference objects to complex numbers (e.g., 6 0 R becomes 6j).

requirement.description: The parse_xref_table function has IndexError issues due to improper handling of xref table parsing logic. It fails to correctly parse xref entries and construct the expected dictionary structures, causing failures in xref-related tests.
requirement.contract: Function must correctly parse xref tables and return a list of dictionaries with keys 'abs_pos', 'o_num', and 'o_gen'. It should handle both regular xref entries (3 numbers) and object number entries (2 numbers) properly and construct the expected data structures for xref parsing.

requirement.description: The docstruct module has setup errors in SimpleFile and Updating classes that cause test failures. These classes lack proper initialization and method implementations for page list and index length operations.
requirement.contract: Classes should properly initialize and implement required methods for accessing page lists and index lengths. The SimpleFile class should support the methods tested in test_simplefile.py and the Updating class should support methods tested in test_updating.py.

requirement.description: The replace_ref function has flawed logic for converting PDF reference objects (e.g., 6 0 R) to complex numbers. It doesn't properly detect and convert reference patterns, which breaks reference parsing in arrays and dictionaries.
requirement.contract: Function must properly detect reference patterns (number 0 R) and convert them to complex numbers (e.g., 6 0 R becomes 6j). It should correctly process tokens and identify valid reference formats.
